owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Team or person who answers for this component.

limits.title: Limits
limits.description: Execution limits to tighten in this environment

wait.title: Wait
wait.description: Run synchronously (CI/tests). Default: run in the background.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Run the version deployed to this environment (development, test, staging, production)

to_version.title: To Version
to_version.description: The version being introduced, for compatibility checks

change.title: Change
change.description: What is changing (recorded in the audit log)

performed.title: Performed
performed.description: True if the side effect happened (never repeated); false to allow a retry.

resume.title: Resume
resume.description: Recover the execution from its last checkpoint afterwards.

directory.title: Directory
directory.description: Directory inside AF_KNOWLEDGE_DIR or the bundled examples

models.title: Models
models.description: Model configurations, e.g. {provider: ollama, model: qwen3:8b}.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.default: Reply with the single word: ready

as_role.title: As Role
as_role.description: Evaluate as another role (admin, developer, operator, ...)

objective.title: Objective
objective.description: Ratio 0 to 1 for rates, milliseconds for latency
